about: The Duo's side of plot requests (ADR-0018): asking the laptop to plot a DWG with no PDF, waiting for its answer and the check-in, and taking the PDF. Counts are budgets enforced by PlotRequestTests in VellumCore, on a made-up Dropbox with the laptop played by the test and a made-up clock, so they are deterministic.

entries.note: One files/upload, mode add, per ask. Asking again for the same entry while its request is open writes nothing.
The request file for the fixture's E-201, format 1 as docs/plot-requests.md writes it. A request grows only with its DWG path and layout name; the laptop refuses one over 4 KB.

While a request is new (its first 2 minutes): a look every 5 s, each one files/download of the request's answer (a not-found reply of about 100 bytes until the laptop writes one, then the answer's 300 to 400 bytes), and files/get_metadata of laptop.json once a minute (a reply of about 400 bytes). About 1 KB a request with its headers, so about 13 KB a minute.

After its first 2 minutes, for as long as it stays open: a look every 30 s and the check-in once a minute, about 3 KB a minute. Nothing at all while nothing is open, while offline, signed out or off the screen.
The plotted PDF comes down once, through the app's one SheetPDFs, under the answer's content hash; the viewer, Add sheet and placing then use that file with no download.
